summary: Round 15 re-check, written 27 Sep ~05:50Z. Three old conclusions were re-read against the D1 fact that DeepCenter safe-div 0.25 -> 0.30 costs -0.005 public (probe 41). The lab had said +0.0013 on 6bba. (A) v3's 'division budget ladder / 144-config insertion retune: division knobs are invisible on public'. The magnitude premise is now WRONG for DeepCenter-gated safe divisions: 20 dummy forks moved public by 0.004-0.006. A per-fork calibration now exists (x138 average ~0.0006 per dummy fork; DC band 0.25-0.30 ~0.00025; insertion forks 0-0.00015). The insertion-knob closure is UPHELD for a new reason: cap 6 adds <= ~6 dummy forks whose lab marginal is 0 TP / 4 FP. exp70g stays unsubmitted, and the exp60 lab may no longer set the sign of any division knob. (B) The 11 Sep sjlee read 'DeepCenter threshold is flat on public (0.15/0.20/0.25 = 0.946-0.947)' is PARTLY OVERTURNED. The response is asymmetric: a plateau at or below 0.25 and a cliff above it. x138's public-tuned 0.25 sits at the knee. So probes 43/44 (0.20/0.225) will most likely display 0.954 with no UP, and a tie should close the DC line (no 0.15 rung). (C) v2's finals E[max]-diversify, applied to a DC-diverse F2 (exp70d instead of #38). The E[score] arithmetic favours it by 0 to +0.0007 whenever sigma_D is large. The utility that matters is P(above the ~350-team x138 block), and there #38's insertion hedge wins (~0.94 vs ~0.89). It would also be post-hoc against the only unseen-embryo read. Finals {#37, #38} are unchanged. No finding creates a new mechanism or needs a submit before R8.
